title: Mesh convergence: cantilever
sentence: The cantilever solved at three mesh sizes by `study.converge`, with the observed rate and a Richardson estimate of the converged value.
theory: With a refinement ratio $r = 2$ and values $f_1, f_2, f_3$ from coarse to fine, the observed order is $p = \dfrac{\ln\!\left(\dfrac{f_1 - f_2}{f_2 - f_3}\right)}{\ln r}$ and Richardson extrapolation gives $f_\infty \approx f_3 + \dfrac{f_3 - f_2}{r^p - 1}$. This run reports $p \approx 1.1$: the tip probe sits in the Saint-Venant zone of the applied traction, so the mesh is not yet in the asymptotic range even though $f_\infty$ already lands within $0.2\,\%$ of beam theory.
